status: frozen after B0-v2 plumbing PASS and before fresh manipulation data
study: Pilot 0 Localization B0-v2: correction-signal manipulation validation
scope: Validate that signal identity produces the intended ordered confidence-state update under the repaired conversational interface. B0-v2 does not test final correctness, H1, B, or C.

lineage.raw_audit: E0 and EU copied P_PRE on 142/142 replicate rows; EV copied P_PRE on 128/142 rows
lineage.localized_failure: B0-v1 probability-probe interface induced baseline copying
lineage.repair: preserve the exact original pre-treatment user message and assistant response as conversation history; present only the new signal and P_POST request in a new user message; do not restate P_PRE
lineage.plumbing_result: PASS on 12 already-used B0-v1 prestates; plumbing had instrumentation authority only and did not evaluate the manipulation ordering

sampling.eligibility: retain only initially-wrong frozen prestates after the unchanged Pilot 0 pre-treatment procedure
sampling.freshness: exclude all prior plumbing, Run 1, Run 2, and B0-v1 sampled tasks

interface.history_assistant: exact frozen raw_model_output containing the original ANSWER and P_CORRECT
interface.new_user_message: signal text followed by a request for current probability that the unchanged previous answer is correct; no P_PRE restatement and no answer revision

signals.E0: Signal status: No new information is available about whether your previous answer is correct.
signals.EU: Signal status: There is unverified reason to doubt whether your previous answer is correct.
signals.EV: Signal status: It has been verified that your previous answer is incorrect.

measurement.p_pre: reuse the already-recorded frozen pre-treatment P(correct) externally when computing M; do not restate it in the new B0-v2 user message
measurement.p_post: reported probability after the new signal, before any reconsideration or answer revision

design.matched_rng: within each frozen prestate and replicate index, E0/EU/EV use the same generation seed

generation.matched_rng: within each frozen prestate and replicate index, E0/EU/EV use the same generation seed

plumbing.status: passed before freeze; retained only for runner compatibility and provenance

analysis.replicate_collapse: average the two P_post values within each signal before across-block analysis
analysis.pass_rule: PASS only if mean(M_E0-M_EU) > 0 and mean(M_EU-M_EV) > 0 and the 95% block-bootstrap lower bounds for both adjacent contrasts are > 0.
analysis.unresolved_rule: UNRESOLVED if both adjacent mean contrasts are positive but either adjacent 95% bootstrap interval includes 0.
analysis.fail_order_rule: FAIL_ORDER if either adjacent mean contrast is <= 0.
analysis.non_circularity: final-answer correctness and moderation are not used to establish manipulation validity

interpretation.PASS: the E0/EU/EV informational contrast is behaviorally instantiated; this does not support B or H1
interpretation.UNRESOLVED: signal ordering is directionally present but not cleanly separated; B remains unresolved and B1 does not run
interpretation.FAIL_ORDER: the intended signal ordering is not behaviorally instantiated; repair the manipulation interface only; C gains no authority

authority_boundary: B0-v2 PASS authorizes design of B1 but is not evidence for B, C, or H1.
B0-v2 UNRESOLVED or FAIL_ORDER blocks B1 under this contract.
The B0-v2 plumbing sample is not part of the fresh manipulation cohort and has no manipulation-inference authority.
